Add references to an instrument

Source: R/references.R
add_references.Rd

Attaches sf_reference() records to an instrument. A reference whose id is already present replaces the old one when replace = TRUE, and is refused otherwise, which keeps a second source from silently taking over a citation key. cited_by targets of a replaced reference are merged.

Usage

add_references(instrument, ..., replace = FALSE)

Arguments

instrument

An sframe object.

...

sf_reference objects, or lists of them such as read_bibtex() returns.

replace

Logical. Replace a reference with the same id.

Value

The instrument, with the references added.

Details

Adding references changes the file hash, as any edit does, and leaves the content hash that amend_sframe() records unchanged: citing a source is disclosure, outside the design.

Examples

instr <- sf_instrument("Demo", components = list(
  sf_item("q1", "How satisfied are you?", "likert", choice_set = "agree5"),
  sf_choices("agree5", 1:5, c("SD", "D", "N", "A", "SA"))
))
instr <- add_references(instr, sf_reference(
  "likert_1932", "A technique for the measurement of attitudes",
  author = "Likert, R.", year = 1932, container = "Archives of Psychology",
  volume = "22", issue = "140", pages = "1-55", cited_by = "item:q1"
))
length(sframe_references(instr))
#> [1] 1
